presentation.summary: Send new completed watches from Silo to Yamtrack.
presentation.description_markdown: Sends newly completed movies and episodes to Yamtrack immediately on playback stop, with scheduled export as a fallback. Shared watch-history IDs prevent duplicate live and scheduled deliveries. Optional TMDB lookup resolves missing episode IDs from the show and episode numbering.
presentation.setup_markdown: Mount a writable persistent directory at /var/lib/yambridge in the Silo container. Connect your profile with the complete Yamtrack Jellyfin webhook URL as the API key. Enable Send watched changes and Scrobble playback. For episodes missing TVDB/IMDb IDs, add a TMDB API Read Access Token in this plugin's settings. Existing connections do not need to reconnect. See README for setup and limitations.

global_config_schema.title: Episode ID lookup (optional)
global_config_schema.description: Resolve missing episode TVDB/IMDb IDs using TMDB show identity and season/episode numbers. Not needed for movies or episodes already carrying those IDs.

fields.label: TMDB API Read Access Token
fields.description: Optional bearer token from your TMDB account's API settings. Use the API Read Access Token, not the v3 API key. Sent only to api.themoviedb.org.

capabilities.description: Paste your complete Yamtrack Jellyfin webhook URL in the API key field.
